## What changed

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, lint, unit tests, build)
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes, or browser behaviour is unchanged
- [ ] Played it: the change was checked by a human in a browser, not only by tests
- [ ] No new network calls, identifiers, analytics, third-party scripts or free-text input (see `.agents/skills/coppa-data-minimization`)
- [ ] New assets are listed in `assets/ATTRIBUTION.md` with provenance (see `.agents/skills/asset-license-audit`)
- [ ] New UI text is in both locale files; no text baked into images
